title: SpaceX maps path toward 10 GW of compute after signing $14.1 billion of cloud contracts: Q2 Earnings
excerpt: SpaceX’s AI infrastructure business reached 1.4 GW of nameplate capacity as compute spending drove quarterly capital expenditures above $18 billion.
content_html:
SpaceX (NASDAQ: SPCX) reported $7.814 billion in second-quarter revenue, a 92% increase year over year, as it expanded its AI infrastructure business. Its net loss came down to $541 million from $1.008 billion.

During the quarter, the company entered into Cloud Services Agreements totaling $14.1 billion in contracted sales. The resulting agreements brought in $1.6 billion of additional AI infrastructure revenue, while total AI segment revenue rose 247% to $2.561 billion.

SpaceX spent $18.369 billion on capital expenditures during the quarter, including $15.828 billion for AI compute infrastructure. Chief Financial Officer Bret Johnsen said new compute deployments currently have a payback period of less than one year.

Compute capacity could approach 10 GW

SpaceX ended June with 1.4 GW of nameplate compute capacity, up from 1.0 GW in the first quarter and 0.4 GW a year earlier. The company is continuing construction at Colossus II while allocating capacity to its Grok models and external cloud customers.

"We expect to end this year with over two gigawatts of compute," Executive Chairman and Chief Executive Elon Musk said during the earnings call.

Musk said cumulative capacity online by the end of 2027 could be "closer to 10 gigawatts of compute than 5 gigawatt of compute." The forecast describes SpaceX's planned deployment trajectory rather than operating or contracted capacity.

Chief Operating Officer Gwynne Shotwell named Google and Anthropic as outside users or potential users of SpaceX compute. Johnsen added that SpaceX had also booked another $6.7 billion in cloud services revenue in the opening weeks of the third quarter, covering a six-month period that starts ramping in October.

Nvidia hardware planned for terrestrial and orbital systems

Musk said SpaceX would use Nvidia hardware exclusively for its future compute expansion. The company is developing a StarMind AI satellite around an optimized version of Nvidia's NVL72 design, with initial launches expected in 2027.

"We expect to actually deploy this on the ground as well as in orbit," Musk said. SpaceX has not disclosed the planned capacity split, construction costs or deployment schedule for the terrestrial and orbital systems.

The AI segment remained unprofitable on an operating basis, recording a $1.257 billion loss in the quarter. Segment Adjusted EBITDA, however, turned positive at $1.146 billion, compared with a $609 million loss in the first quarter.

content_html_zh:
SpaceX（纳斯达克股票代码：SPCX）公布第二季度营收为 78.14 亿美元，同比增长 92%，该公司扩大了人工智能基础设施业务。 其净亏损从 10.08 亿美元降至 5.41 亿美元。

本季度，该公司签订的云服务协议合同销售额总计 141 亿美元。 由此产生的协议带来了 16 亿美元的额外 AI 基础设施收入，而 AI 部门总收入增长了 247％，达到 25.61 亿美元。

SpaceX 本季度资本支出为 183.69 亿美元，其中 158.28 亿美元用于人工智能计算基础设施。 首席财务官 Bret Johnsen 表示，新计算部署目前的投资回收期不到一年。

计算容量可能接近 10 GW

截至 6 月份，SpaceX 的标称计算容量为 1.4 GW，高于第一季度的 1.0 GW 和去年同期的 0.4 GW。 该公司正在继续 Colossus II 的建设，同时为其 Grok 模型和外部云客户分配容量。

执行董事长兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克在财报电话会议上表示：“我们预计今年年底的计算能力将超过 2 吉瓦。”

马斯克表示，到 2027 年底，累计在线容量可能“接近 10 吉瓦计算能力，而不是 5 吉瓦计算能力”。 该预测描述了 SpaceX 计划的部署轨迹，而不是运营或合同容量。

首席运营官 Gwynne Shotwell 将 Google 和 Anthropic 称为 SpaceX 计算的外部用户或潜在用户。 Johnsen 补充说，SpaceX 在第三季度的前几周还确认了另外 67 亿美元的云服务收入，涵盖从 10 月份开始的六个月期间。

Nvidia 硬件计划用于地面和轨道系统

马斯克表示，SpaceX 将专门使用 Nvidia 硬件来实现未来的计算扩展。 该公司正在围绕 Nvidia NVL72 设计的优化版本开发 StarMind AI 卫星，预计将于 2027 年首次发射。

“我们希望在地面和轨道上实际部署它，”马斯克说。 SpaceX 尚未透露陆地和轨道系统的计划产能分配、建设成本或部署时间表。

AI 部门在运营基础上仍处于亏损状态，本季度亏损 12.57 亿美元。 然而，部门调整后 EBITDA 转正，达到 11.46 亿美元，而第一季度亏损 6.09 亿美元。
